findings.defect_statement: The new 2027 constant is stale at 8,300 instead of 8,550.
findings.impact: Valid 2027 contributions are under-counted by as much as 250.
findings.title: The 2027 cap repeats the 2026 amount
findings.trigger: Apply the cap to a 2027 contribution above 8,300.

findings.impact: Invalid negative contributions silently reduce the total.
findings.title: Negative contributions are no longer rejected
findings.trigger: Call contribution_total with a negative element.

findings.defect_statement: average_contribution divides by len(amounts) without an empty-input guard.
findings.impact: A valid empty collection causes ZeroDivisionError instead of a domain error.
findings.title: Average crashes on an empty list

findings.defect_statement: annual_report still calls apply_cap without forwarding year.
findings.impact: The report labels output as 2027 while calculating with 2026 rules.
findings.title: Annual reports ignore their requested plan year
findings.trigger: Generate a 2027 report for a contribution above the 2026 cap.

findings.defect_statement: CAPS accepts 2027 while rules.SUPPORTED_YEARS still lists only 2026.
findings.impact: Different code paths disagree about whether 2027 is supported.
findings.title: The supported-year registry omits 2027
findings.trigger: A caller validates 2027 against the repository rule registry.

findings.defect_statement: The replacement report test checks only the echoed year and removes the base test's capped_total assertion.
findings.impact: The report path can stop applying contribution caps without a test failure.
findings.title: The report test drops its capping assertion
findings.trigger: Regress annual_report so it reports an uncapped total for 2027.
